{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 4 slices (⅔ inch thick) stale [[Cookbook:Brioche|brioche]] [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]], beaten
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 tbsp unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] pure [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract

== Procedure ==
#Spread cream cheese on half the bread. Press into sort of a sandwich and set aside.
#Combine egg, vanilla, cream, sugar, and salt in a pie pan. Add bread "sandwiches" to mixture and coat both sides.
#Melt 1 tbsp butter in a small nonstick [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] heated between medium and medium high. Add 1 "sandwich" to pan and cook until golden brown on both sides.
#Remove from pan. Melt remaining butter and repeat.
#Serve immediately with maple syrup, powdered sugar, whipped cream, or fresh fruit.
